text: dsh-priceflow 为 DSH Web 对话区添加 DeepSeek 价格与低谷发送控件，显示峰价/低谷状态、切换倒计时、官方价格及可用时的账户余额。峰价期间可将符合条件的纯文本排队，等待低谷时段投递；附件不支持延迟发送。余额查询使用 DSH 凭据或可选的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

dsh-priceflow adds a pricing and send panel to DSH web conversations. It shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, transition time and prices. Eligible text can queue at peak for off-peak delivery; attachments are not supported. Balance lookup uses available DSH credentials or an optional key.
想知道 DeepSeek 什么时候是低谷价，并看到切换倒计时。
峰价时先把纯文本排队，等到低谷再发出去。
Show me whether DeepSeek is at peak or off-peak and when the phase changes.
dsh-priceflow 的功能「低谷发送排队」：在对话输入区对符合条件的纯文本使用低谷发送操作；峰价时加入队列等待低谷，低谷时可立即提交。附件和斜杠命令不走此延迟队列。
dsh-priceflow 的功能「价格与余额面板」：对话区域展示价格阶段、下次切换倒计时、价格详情和队列状态；余额在可用凭据时可刷新查询。
价格刷新访问 DeepSeek 定价页；余额查询用 DSH 凭据访问 api.deepseek.com（见 balance-fetcher.mjs:1,30）。
dsh-priceflow 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 23 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-priceflow README · dsh-priceflow：DeepSeek pricing and off-peak scheduling for DeepSeek Harness.

[中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-priceflow README · What it does：PriceFlow adds a status panel and an explicit off-peak action to the DSH conversation composer. It displays the current PEAK or OFF-PEAK phase, a countdown to the next transition, official USD pricing, and official Chinese-page CNY pricing. CNY is shown as published; it is not converted from USD and does not drive scheduling.

dsh-priceflow README · What it does：During PEAK, you can queue a text message for OFF-PEAK delivery. During OFF-PEAK, ordinary DSH sending remains the normal send flow. PriceFlow can also show your DeepSeek account balance when DSH credentials are available.

dsh-priceflow README · Requirements：- Node.js 20 or newer
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` (DSH prereleases included)

PriceFlow has been tested against DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2`. Future `0.2.x` versions are admitted by the range but are not individually API-verified; Host or Client API changes may require a plugin fix.

dsh-priceflow README · Installation：In a terminal, add the npm package to the profile where you want PriceFlow installed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-priceflow
```

Replace `<profile>` with the DSH profile name. The declared DSH range is bounded below `0.3.0`; no version exemption is used. In DSH Desktop builds that expose an in-app Plugins page, use that page to install the package into the Desktop profile.

dsh-priceflow README · Phase and countdown：PriceFlow uses the official DeepSeek pricing schedule to show PEAK and OFF-PEAK and the time until the next transition. Phase comes from the Host pricing engine; the Client does not calculate or flip it locally.

dsh-priceflow README · USD and CNY pricing：USD prices come from DeepSeek's official pricing page. CNY prices come from DeepSeek's official Chinese pricing page. CNY is display-only and never changes the scheduler's USD pricing policy.

dsh-priceflow README · Off-peak queue：During PEAK, the PriceFlow action can queue text for OFF-PEAK delivery. During OFF-PEAK, ordinary DSH sends follow the normal DSH flow. Delayed queue sends are text-only; attachments are not supported. Queue data survives Host restarts. Delivery uses a durable at-least-once architecture, so a message may be attempted again after an interrupted delivery. A missing send API, an API error, or a response without the explicit `accepted: true` contract is rejected; the queued message is retained and is never marked submitted on that basis. Retryable failures use capped backoff and a finite attempt limit. A `submitted` status means DSH accepted the submission; it does not mean the model completed its response. Delivery remains at-least-once, not exactly-once, so an interrupted request may have an uncertain outcome.

dsh-priceflow README · Pricing trust：PriceFlow reads official DeepSeek pricing sources and validates the result before using it. A verified Last Known Good (LKG) policy can continue to be used after a refresh failure, with a stale-data warning. A bundled pricing fixture is for reference only and does not authorize scheduling. If a model's price is unknown, its displayed price may be unavailable while phase detection continues.

dsh-priceflow README · Holiday scheduling：Chinese public holidays are excluded from weekday PEAK scheduling. Weekends remain OFF-PEAK, including make-up work weekends. If required holiday-calendar coverage is missing, automatic scheduling fails closed.

dsh-priceflow README · Account balance：When DSH credentials are available, PriceFlow can request balance data from DeepSeek's official balance endpoint. Balance failures do not affect pricing, phase detection, or queue scheduling.

dsh-priceflow README · Privacy and local data：Queued delayed text and related queue metadata, including the target session ID, are stored locally so the queue can survive restarts. The default queue file is `%DSH_HOME%\\priceflow\\queue.json`.

The balance API key is resolved and used on the Host side; PriceFlow does not send the raw key to the Client. Balance values are held in memory and are not intentionally persisted or logged by PriceFlow. PriceFlow does not add its own telemetry.

dsh-priceflow README · Official sources：- [DeepSeek pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/)
- [DeepSeek Chinese pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)
- [DeepSeek balance endpoint](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/get-user-balance)

dsh-priceflow README · Limitations：- Compatibility is intentionally limited to the independently verified DSH versions `0.2.0-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2`.
- Delayed queue sends support text only; attachments are not supported.
- Automatic scheduling requires a verified pricing policy.
- Missing holiday-calendar coverage may intentionally disable automatic scheduling.
- Queue delivery is at-least-once; there is no general exactly-once guarantee.

npm run check
npm run verify
```

dsh-priceflow README · dsh-priceflow：DeepSeek Harness 的官方价格时段显示与低谷发送调度插件。

[English](README.md)

dsh-priceflow README · 功能简介：PriceFlow 在 DSH 对话输入框区域显示价格时段状态，并提供单独的低谷发送操作。它展示当前是峰价时段（PEAK）还是低谷时段（OFF-PEAK）、距离下一次切换的倒计时、DeepSeek 官方 USD 价格，以及官方中文价格页面公布的 CNY 价格。CNY 是页面展示值，不是由 USD 汇率换算所得，也不参与调度。

PEAK 期间可以将文本消息排入低谷队列。OFF-PEAK 期间，普通发送仍使用 DSH 原有发送流程。DSH 凭据可用时，PriceFlow 也可以显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

dsh-priceflow README · 环境要求：- Node.js 20 或更新版本
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`（包含 prerelease）

已针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` 和 `0.2.0-rc.2` 完成验证。版本范围允许后续 `0.2.x` 通过元数据兼容检查，但这些未来版本尚未逐一验证 API；Host 或 Client API 变化仍可能需要发布插件修复。

dsh-priceflow README · 安装：在终端中将 npm 包添加到目标 DSH profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-priceflow
```

将 `<profile>` 替换为 DSH profile 名称。声明的 DSH 版本范围上界为 `0.3.0-0`，不使用版本豁免。如果所用 DSH Desktop 版本提供应用内 Plugins 页面，可通过该页面将包安装到 Desktop profile。
dsh-priceflow README · 价格时段与倒计时：PriceFlow 按 DeepSeek 官方价格时段显示 PEAK、OFF-PEAK，以及距离下一次切换的时间。时段由 Host 定价引擎计算，Client 不会自行计算或切换时段。
dsh-priceflow README · USD 与 CNY 价格：USD 价格来自 DeepSeek 官方价格页面；CNY 价格来自 DeepSeek 官方中文价格页面。CNY 仅用于展示，不会改变基于 USD 定价策略的调度。

dsh-priceflow README · 低谷队列：PEAK 期间，PriceFlow 可以将文本排队，等待 OFF-PEAK 投递。OFF-PEAK 期间，普通发送遵循 DSH 原有流程。延迟队列只支持文本，不支持附件。队列会持久化，以便 Host 重启后恢复。投递采用持久化的至少一次（at-least-once）架构，发送 API 缺失、调用报错或响应不满足明确的 `accepted: true` 契约时会拒绝确认，队列消息会保留且不会标为 `submitted`。可重试错误采用有上限的退避和有限尝试次数。`submitted` 表示 DSH 已接受提交，不表示模型已经完成回复。投递仍是 at-least-once，而非 exactly-once；请求中断时结果可能不确定。
dsh-priceflow README · 定价可信状态：PriceFlow 只读取并验证 DeepSeek 官方价格来源。刷新失败时，可以继续使用此前验证过的最近一次有效策略（Last Known Good，LKG），并显示数据过期警告。内置价格 fixture 仅供参考，不能授权调度。模型价格未知时，价格可能显示为不可用，但价格时段仍可正常判断。
dsh-priceflow README · 节假日调度：中国法定节假日不按工作日 PEAK 时段调度。周末始终为 OFF-PEAK，调休工作周末也一样。缺少必要的节假日日历覆盖时，自动调度会安全关闭。
dsh-priceflow README · 账户余额：DSH 凭据可用时，PriceFlow 可以请求 DeepSeek 官方余额接口。余额请求失败不会影响价格引擎、时段判断或队列调度。

dsh-priceflow README · 隐私与本地数据：为了让队列在重启后恢复，待延迟发送的文本及相关队列元数据（包括目标 session ID）会保存在本地。默认队列文件为 `%DSH_HOME%\\priceflow\\queue.json`。

余额 API key 由 Host 端解析和使用；PriceFlow 不会把原始 key 发送给 Client。余额数值保存在内存中，PriceFlow 不会有意将其持久化或写入日志。PriceFlow 自身不添加遥测。

dsh-priceflow README · 官方来源：- [DeepSeek 价格页面](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/)
- [DeepSeek 中文价格页面](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)
- [DeepSeek 余额接口](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/get-user-balance)

dsh-priceflow README · 限制：- 兼容范围有意限定为已分别验证的 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2`。
- 延迟队列只支持文本，不支持附件。
- 自动调度需要已验证的价格策略。
- 节假日日历覆盖不足时，自动调度可能会按设计关闭。
- 队列采用至少一次投递；不保证通用的 exactly-once。
